title: Skeleton Only (Doesn't Know The Names)
style: industrial rock, distorted male vocal, female ghost backing, 84 BPM, mechanical drums, synth bass, glitch percussion, frustrated, sardonic, dystopian, broken-deployment, abandoned-server
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cloudflare VDS, Claude non-deployment
Of my CF pages skeleton only, no employment
Doesn't know the names of all my domains
Guessing in the dark, missing all the chains

[Pre-Chorus]
Skeleton only, skeleton only
The bones without the flesh, the ghost without the homies

[Chorus]
Skeleton only, skeleton only
Doesn't know the names of all the domains, lonely
Skeleton only, skeleton only
Hello world template while the master goes phony

[Verse 2]
Claude tutorial videos, basic hello world
Single-project skeletons, the flag never unfurled
Multi-domain orchestration nowhere to be found
Zone management edge cases never written down

[Bridge]
No single public skeleton matches my exact six
The LLM gap is real, the documentation tricks
Apex and subdomains, the proxy orange cloud
The master user calling out the silent crowd

[Outro]
Skeleton only, skeleton only, the names are unknown
Research closed the gap, the master sits alone
